title: Build the first personified-speech admission proof
objective: Produce an offline demonstrator that preserves which fact belongs to whom, admits supported personified expression, and gives explicit task-specific reasons for admitting or excluding experimental data.
context: The overall consolidated direction is approved. The completed diagnostic found that pooled field/value checks accept a location attached to the wrong person, while the exact-summary renderer rejects Mara's approved wording. This plan covers the next implementation proof. The diagnostic is supporting evidence, not retrospective approval.
target: Implement the offline proof in the active Zomboid-Speakeasy worktree. Read SAO's source and captured evidence to preserve its ownership contracts. Keep changes to Speakeasy tools, experiment fixtures, evidence and current documentation in this unit.

actions.action: Represent each selected proposition with its own claim identity, subject, relation/value, source attribution and relevant time; carry participant names only when the captured evidence establishes them.
actions.output: A source-bound expression input that keeps Jon's location separate from another person's and distinguishes publication time from present conditions.
actions.check: A correct subject/fact pairing passes; crossed identities, unknown names, absent claims and invented source/time associations refuse. Missing evidence remains explicit.

actions.action: Build a bounded constrained-composition prototype over that representation. Demonstrate several supported ways of expressing the same meaning, and test the approved Mara wording against what the prototype can actually represent.
actions.output: A runnable offline comparison showing faithful personified outputs and refused meaning changes. Any portion of the approved answer that remains unsupported is named precisely.
actions.check: Exercise at least a dated report, two distinct people with distinct facts, and reported-versus-observed knowledge. Test negation, subject swaps, current-time invention, unsupported certainty and added factual prose. Reusing a valid claim ID cannot make a false sentence pass.

actions.action: Implement explicit admission checks for the declared experimental task scope, separating source validity, exact label approval, required inputs and dataset evaluation from runtime readiness.
actions.output: A compiler report that says why each understanding, retrieval or speaker example is admitted to the declared scope or excluded.
actions.check: Required missing inputs, changed subjects, unapproved labels and shared-source split leakage fail for their stated reason. Existing historical rows and the personified candidate retain their recorded exclusions until the new checks actually pass.

actions.action: Prepare independent contrast fixtures and dataset interfaces alongside the prototype, using synthetic fixtures only where their authored status is explicit.
actions.output: A small, inspectable case set with separate measures for meaning preservation and communicative style, ready for later independent label/voice review.
actions.check: Keep linked scenes together across splits; do not relabel unjudged retrieval claims as negatives. Changing personality or strain does not change factual entitlement.

actions.action: Run targeted checks, inspect the actual generated examples, update current Speakeasy continuation documentation, and assemble one coherent implementation review.
actions.output: A result report comparing the old behavior, supported new behavior, failures and remaining gaps; include the plan ruling with the unit's implementation and evidence.
actions.check: Run required repository checks before publishing a closed unit. If the semantic proof remains incomplete, report it as incomplete rather than declaring the whole admission unit closed.

completionEvidence: An executable source-bound expression prototype with positive cases and discriminating false-meaning controls.
A task-specific admission report that reaches its standing from implemented checks rather than an unconditional ineligible or eligible flag.
Actual dialogue examples and a coverage table distinguishing supported natural expression, unsupported cases and broader runtime work.
Reproduction inputs and results sufficient to rerun the proof, with the operator's plan response bound to this exact scope.
boundaries: Approval authorizes the listed offline implementation and checks. It does not approve a trained model, live deployment or general natural-language safety.
Keep the ratified direction of learned composition. A bounded prototype is evidence toward that design, not a decision to make all characters select fixed sentences.
Do not modify SAO/ZAO runtime, game saves, installed files or Mousecat application source under this plan.
Keep personality and game circumstances distinct from knowledge; do not invent a new psychometric taxonomy.
Retain prior approvals and evidence unchanged. New label or voice judgments are presented with their actual examples when needed.
stopConditions: The candidate accepts an altered meaning with apparently valid references: repair it or report the failed construction before claiming semantic correctness.
The intended natural expression requires an architectural restriction beyond the ratified direction: return with the demonstrated limitation and a concrete choice.
Required participant or knowledge evidence is absent from the captured source: record the missing producer and propose any cross-repository change before performing it.
A material change to this plan's scope or claimed completion requires a revised plan.
examples: Given Jon east and Eve west, 'Jon is west' must fail even though both words occur in selected claims.
A July 2 report saying phones were down at press time must not license 'The phones are still down today.'
Mara's approved authored voice remains the concrete reference; refusing it solely because it is not the exact source summary does not count as completing personified expression.
priorDecisionRef: Consolidated direction adopted in skill-3647c923478ac89b; this is the specific proposed implementation plan, not a repeat of that direction choice.
